assets.name: ribbon-palace
assets.prompt: Production platform sprite for a SIDE-VIEW precision platformer. High-fidelity 16-bit pixel art matching a detailed pink-haired magical-girl sprite: rose pink, ivory, ruby gems, lavender shadows, delicate warm gold trim. Rich hand-painted pixel clusters, crisp fine texture and polished anime fantasy aesthetic. Original magical-girl world, no franchise characters, no text, no UI, no watermark. One isolated long horizontal platform, about 5:1 width to body height. Orthographic SIDE VIEW with no perspective, NO visible top plane. Absolutely straight continuous level landing edge. Entire top supported by solid material below it, no holes in upper half. Sculpted ornate underside. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background, generous empty margins. No objects projecting ABOVE the landing line. Base model: pearlescent ivory marble ledge, rose quartz core, ruby heart jewel inset in the middle of the front face, finely engraved gold star filigree, sculpted pink ribbon motifs below the lip, layered porcelain detail. Beautiful restrained rim highlight.
